behavior: AC1: every measured lesson shape normalises to the canonical form, idempotently
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/lessons/ -run '^TestNormalize_EveryShapeReachesTheCanonicalForm$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestNormalize_EveryShapeReachesTheCanonicalForm'

behavior: AC2: the index table is generated between markers and the prose kept
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/lessons/ -run '^TestRenderIndex_ReplacesTheHandKeptTableOnceThenItsMarkers$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestRenderIndex_ReplacesTheHandKeptTableOnceThenItsMarkers'

behavior: AC3: a duplicate number is an error
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/lessons/ -run '^TestPlan_RefusesANumberUsedTwice$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestPlan_RefusesANumberUsedTwice'

behavior: AC4: the repository's lessons are in their canonical form
verification: cd cli && go run ./cmd/dotf lessons fmt --check --dir ../docs/lessons

behavior: AC5: the init index template is what fmt renders
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/initrepo/ -run '^TestLessonsIndexTemplateIsWhatFmtRenders$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestLessonsIndexTemplateIsWhatFmtRenders'

behavior: AC7: a wikilink that names no lesson is an error
verification: cd cli && go test ./internal/lessons/ -run '^TestPlan_RefusesAWikilinkThatNamesNoLesson$' -count=1 -v | grep -q -- '--- PASS: TestPlan_RefusesAWikilinkThatNamesNoLesson'

behavior: AC7: pre-commit runs fmt --check and the shell check is gone
verification: grep -qF 'entry: dotf lessons fmt --check' .pre-commit-config.yaml && test ! -e scripts/check-lessons.sh
